handback.title: Generic shipped prompts and the planner's questions
handback.summary: Shipped prompts drop Dokima's file names, share one raising text, draw limits from settings, and teach planner questions.
handback.user_story: Any repo's agents get prompts with neutral examples, its own limits, and clear rules for asking the owner.

acceptance_criteria.text: A scan of the shipped prompts finds no file name from Dokima's own code.
acceptance_criteria.words: a scan finds no Dokima file name in any shipped prompt

edge_cases.case: The new shared raising file is scanned too.
Prompts as built for a repo with no settings file.

acceptance_criteria.text: The raising rules are written once, in one shared raising prompt file.
acceptance_criteria.words: moves to one shared `roles/raising.md` with neutral examples

edge_cases.case: A role prompt that keeps its own copy of the rules.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's, worker's and reviewer's prompts each carry the shared raising rules.
acceptance_criteria.words: The 50-line "raising" block copied into planner, worker and reviewer

edge_cases.case: The reviewer's prompt at both plan review and code review.
A prompt that holds the rules twice.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's prompt states the question limit the questions setting names.
acceptance_criteria.words: Numbers written into prompts ("more than 3 questions", "three blocks in a row", word caps) are read from settings.

edge_cases.case: No settings file: the prompt says more than 3 questions.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each prompt states the blocks-in-a-row limit the blocks setting names.
acceptance_criteria.words: Numbers written into prompts ("more than 3 questions", "three blocks in a row", word caps) are read from settings.

edge_cases.case: No settings file: each prompt names 3 blocks in a row.
The example no longer says the third build.

edge_cases.case: The old rule against a formula no longer contradicts it.

acceptance_criteria.words: The planner tries to write each criterion with a source, a result

raises.label: Prompts folder rule
raises.text: Should the worker's rule against editing Dokima's prompts folder move into Dokima's own settings? The plan assumes it should.
raises.evidence: The worker's prompt names `dokima/roles/`, a Dokima path the scan must not find; protected paths come from settings.
